name: crouched-walking
intent: A looped crouched walk with alternating steps while the body stays low and forward, accompanied by compact arm motion.

phases.description: leg A lift → swing-through to loop seam

weightTransfer: Pelvis shifts laterally toward +X/right into mid-cycle, then returns toward its starting lateral position by the loop seam. Support-leg identity is intentionally not asserted.
bodyMechanics: Sustained hip/knee flexion and forward torso lean keep the body low; compact low arms accompany opposed root/chest yaw changes across the cycle.

recommended: alternating leg placement and lateral pelvis transfer in a sustained crouch
compact upper-body and arm mechanics for crouched walking
